reason: After the audit I went through, my compliance records are the last thing I'll hand to a company with no customers at all. The export promise and the 60-day refund are nice, but I'd rather wait until a few other operators have been through an audit using it.
objection: If they fold, an Excel dump doesn't help me. I need to show an auditor proper records of driver authorities and vehicle inspections, and I'd be back to rebuilding everything in the middle of a busy season. It also says nothing about working with the GPS trackers I already pay for.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to two or three operators like me who have used it through a real accreditation audit, with the auditor accepting its records.
